result.quote: “Please inquire of God to determine whether we will have a successful journey.”
result.reason: The intended answer is explicit: they want to know whether their journey will succeed. However, the exact window identifies the parties only as “they” and “him/the priest”; it never identifies them as the people of Dan or identifies him as a Levite. The wording is also unnatural; it should use “the people of Dan” and “the Levite,” preferably in the past tense.
